Frequently asked questions

Which regulations do these courses follow?
  • Cal/OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Hazardous Waste Operations and Emergency Response (HAZWOPER) Standards for the Construction Industry (29 CFR 1926.65) and General Industry (29 CFR 1910.120).
  • Cal/OSHA Chemical Handling Safety Training: in accordance with Title 8 California Code of Regulations Section 5194, 5141, and 5155.
  • Cal/OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training: in accordance with Cal/OSHA HAZWOPER Regulations in Title 8, Section 5192 Paragraphs (a) to (q), and Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.120(e) and 29 CFR 1926.65(e).
  • Cal/OSHA 24-Hour HAZWOPER Training: in accordance with Cal/OSHA HAZWOPER Regulations in Title 8, Section 5192 Paragraphs (a) to (q), and Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.120(e) and 29 CFR 1926.65(e).
  • Cal/OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER Training (2026): in accordance with Cal/OSHA HAZWOPER Regulations in Title 8, Section 5192 Paragraphs (a) to (q), and Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.120(e) and 29 CFR 1926.65(e).
How long does Cal/OSHA HAZWOPER Training take?
  • Cal/OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training: 1 hour.
  • Cal/OSHA Chemical Handling Safety Training: 2 hours.
  • Cal/OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training: 8 hours.
  • Cal/OSHA 24-Hour HAZWOPER Training: 24 hours.
  • Cal/OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER Training (2026): 40 hours.

Training is self-paced, so you can stop and pick up where you left off at any time.

How long do I have to finish?

You get a 3-month completion timeline, 1-year access to training materials.

Do I get a certificate?

Yes. You can download your certificate of completion as soon as you pass the final exam.

The certificate is valid for 12 months before a refresher is required.

Can I take the training on my phone?

Yes. The training is 100% online and works on phones, tablets and computers, 24 hours a day.

Can I buy training for my whole team?

Yes. Enter the number of seats at checkout. Team pricing starts at 2 seats and goes up to 10% off for 501–1,000 seats. For larger orders or invoicing, call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

Is the training available in Spanish?

Yes. All 5 courses are available in English and Spanish.

How do I start my course after I pay?

Right after checkout you'll get an email with your receipt and your login for the learning portal. Sign in at hazwoper-osha.com to begin.

Who provides the training?

Courses are delivered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC on its online learning portal at hazwoper-osha.com. Questions? Call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

What is the refund policy?

See the refund policy on hazwoper-osha.com, or call us before you start a course.
